bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY NOW IN EFFECT FROM 2 PM THIS AFTERNOON TO 5 AM PDT SATURDAY... Combined seas 6 to 8 ft rising to 9 to 11 ft this afternoon. Seas easing to 7 to 9 ft Saturday morning. Bar conditions moderate becoming rough this afternoon easing back to moderate Saturday morning. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 400 AM and 430 PM today and 445 AM Saturday. The afternoon ebb will be strong.
